feedback: Justin’s confession follows directly from the pre-vote clipping, seller condition, laboratory result, and his admitted visit to the glass. Taking poison specifically at the preview supplies a precise action location that was not independently established, but it explains an available opportunity rather than introducing a new decisive proof. The invented neutralization claim was already the decisive contradiction. His concern that the legitimate folder must survive his discredited storytelling gives the confession an emotionally coherent consequence. Chip’s surrender of workbench keys and Barb’s badge response also finish their collateral arcs well. The ending feels earned, though its explanatory neatness continues the earlier deposition style.
